saw_lines: Athletes buy shoes and racquets by fit and feel, then wait for the box before they trust the store.
So the sale is lost in the first line, where a new buyer still wants to know when the order lands.
Your site lists 50% off shipping with prepaid checkout, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. Open new buyer ads with the delivery window and that discount.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site explains delivery and lists 50% off shipping with prepaid checkout, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. A new buyer leaves unsure. Open three ads with the delivery window and the prepaid discount in line one.
Your site explains how orders arrive, yet 0 of 30 ads show the delivery at all. Unknown arrival is a reason to wait. Film one video of the box arriving and run it in place of one Shop now ad.
The same On Cloud copy runs in 5 of 16 written ads, so buyers see one opening line. Keep the body, but give each of the five a new first line and a new image of the shoe on a trail.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer has nothing concrete to weigh against the price. Collect one real figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch of ads with it.

ads_1: Delivery answers up front, On Cloud shoes shot on trails, new opening line each
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
